product.description: A free, open-source AI chatbot that supports multiple input types to assist B2B customer success teams with user support and engagement.

product.name: AI-Powered Product Video Tutorials
product.description: Dynamic video tutorials that update automatically to reflect product changes, aiding onboarding, support, and user education.

product.description: An AI agent that provides instant, accurate responses to customer inquiries, reducing ticket volume and speeding resolution times.

product.name: AI-Powered Interactive Product Tours
product.description: Interactive, AI-driven product tours that provide personalized, real-time guidance to users during onboarding and product use.
